assessment_summary: Step 0016 incorrectly claims that σ[..i] is a bad prefix. Failure of F(P1C ∨ P2C) at position i depends on the entire infinite future of σ. An extension σ′ sharing this prefix may place P1C or P2C after i, making the eventuality—and therefore the implication at i—true. Thus the asserted conclusion about every extension is unjustified.
